title: AI + MCP Toolchain Atlas
summary: A practical, non-affiliate shortlist and local stack builder for selecting AI work surfaces, MCP bridges, permission posture, and verification evidence.

editorial_policy.top_definition: A compact shortlist selected for practical coverage and useful workflows, not a universal ranking.
editorial_policy.default_permission_posture: Project-scoped configuration, least privilege, read-only first, and human approval before writes.
editorial_policy.warning: Plans, availability, models, prices, data terms, transports, and server tools change. Confirm current terms and permissions with the official publisher before connecting accounts, spending money, or sharing sensitive material.

definitions.ai_tool: A work surface used to think, code, research, design, or make an artifact.
definitions.mcp_server: A permissioned bridge that can expose external context or actions to an MCP-capable host.
definitions.receipt: Inspectable evidence such as a source trail, diff, test, screenshot, log, or public URL.

ai_tools.name: ChatGPT
ai_tools.use_when: The work changes shape as you learn.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.use_when: The source packet is the work.

ai_tools.name: Gemini
ai_tools.use_when: The approved workflow is already Google-shaped.

ai_tools.name: NotebookLM
ai_tools.use_when: The boundary is a known source set.
ai_tools.receipt: The source collection and cited notes.

ai_tools.name: Perplexity
ai_tools.use_when: You need the current source landscape.
ai_tools.receipt: Opened primary links, not citation count.

ai_tools.name: Codex

ai_tools.name: Claude Code

ai_tools.name: Figma Make

ai_tools.name: Runway
ai_tools.receipt: A take sheet with keep and reject reasons.

mcp_servers.name: OpenAI Docs
mcp_servers.use: Search and read official OpenAI developer documentation in the agent context.
mcp_servers.first_test: Find one current API field and return the exact official source page.
mcp_servers.boundary: Documentation-only; it does not call the OpenAI API on the user's behalf.

mcp_servers.name: Context7
mcp_servers.use: Bring current library and framework documentation into a coding session.
mcp_servers.first_test: Resolve one package and retrieve the current method signature.
mcp_servers.boundary: Inspect the package and source before running it locally.

mcp_servers.name: Figma
mcp_servers.transport: local or remote; see publisher guide
mcp_servers.access: account and file scope; tools vary
mcp_servers.use: Expose structured design context and supported Figma actions.
mcp_servers.first_test: Read one named frame and summarize its components.
mcp_servers.boundary: Start with one file and inspect every offered tool.

mcp_servers.name: Playwright
mcp_servers.use: Inspect and operate a browser to test interaction, layout, errors, and responsive behavior.
mcp_servers.first_test: Open a local page, read the title, and take a screenshot.
mcp_servers.boundary: Use a test profile; browser actions can change external state.

mcp_servers.name: Chrome DevTools
mcp_servers.use: Inspect a live browser's DOM, console, network, and performance state.
mcp_servers.first_test: Read console errors from a local or staging route.
mcp_servers.boundary: Avoid personal profiles and authenticated production tabs.

mcp_servers.name: Sentry
mcp_servers.use: Bring issue and error context into a debugging session.
mcp_servers.first_test: Read one test-project issue without changing its state.
mcp_servers.boundary: Scope the organization and project; treat traces as sensitive.

mcp_servers.name: GitHub
mcp_servers.transport: local stdio or supported host setup
mcp_servers.use: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, and security data.
mcp_servers.first_test: Use read-only mode to summarize one issue and linked pull request.
mcp_servers.boundary: Enable only needed toolsets; writes require explicit approval.

stack_builder.share_encoding: URL fragment containing only outcome and posture

permission_gate: Keep a human approval and stop rule for consequential actions.
